title: सप्तनवतितमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 97 · Ninth day: Abhimanyu defeats Alambusha

summary.en: At Dhritarashtra's question Sanjaya tells how Abhimanyu overcame Alambusha by arrows and made him flee. Bhishma then surrounds Abhimanyu with many chariots, and Arjuna comes against Drona.
summary.kn: ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರನ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗೆ ಅಭಿಮನ್ಯು ಅಲಂಬುಷನನ್ನು ಬಾಣಗಳಿಂದ ಗೆದ್ದು ಓಡಿಸಿದ್ದನ್ನು ಸಂಜಯ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಅಭಿಮನ್ಯುವನ್ನು ಅನೇಕ ರಥಗಳಿಂದ ಸುತ್ತುವರಿಯುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಅರ್ಜುನ ದ್ರೋಣನ ಮೇಲೆ ಬರುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: धृतराष्ट्र के प्रश्न पर संजय बताते हैं कि अभिमन्यु ने अलम्बुष को बाणों से हराकर भगा दिया। भीष्म अभिमन्यु को अनेक रथों से घेरते हैं और अर्जुन द्रोण के सामने आते हैं।
summary.te: ధృతరాష్ట్రుని ప్రశ్నకు అభిమన్యుడు అలంబుషుని బాణాలతో ఓడించి తరిమిన తీరును సంజయుడు చెబుతాడు. భీష్ముడు అభిమన్యుని అనేక రథాలతో చుట్టుముడతాడు; అర్జునుడు ద్రోణునిపైకి వస్తాడు.
summary.ta: த்ருதராஷ்டிரன் கேட்க, அபிமன்யு அலம்புசனை அம்புகளால் வென்று துரத்தியதைச் சஞ்சயன் கூறுகிறான். பீஷ்மர் அபிமன்யுவைப் பல தேர்களால் சூழ, அர்ஜுனன் த்ரோணரை எதிர்க்கிறான்.
summary.ml: അലംബുഷനെ അമ്പുകൾകൊണ്ട് പരാജയപ്പെടുത്തി ഓടിച്ചത് ധൃതരാഷ്ട്രരുടെ ചോദ്യത്തിനുത്തരമായി സഞ്ജയൻ വിവരിക്കുന്നു. പിന്നീട് ഭീഷ്മർ അഭിമന്യുവിനെ നിരവധി രഥങ്ങൾകൊണ്ട് വളയുന്നു; അർജുനൻ ദ്രോണർക്കെതിരെ നീങ്ങുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 6.97; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 26 2021

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
आर्जुनिं समरे शूरं विनिघ्नन्तं महारथम् ।
अलम्बुसः कथं युद्धे प्रत्ययुध्यत संजय ॥

meaning.en: Sanjaya, how did Alambusha fight in battle against the heroic great chariot-warrior, Arjuna's son, who was cutting down my men?

verses.text:
आर्श्यशृङ्गिं कथं चापि सौभद्रः परवीरहा ।
तन्ममाचक्ष्व तत्त्वेन यथा वृत्तं स्म संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: And how did Saubhadra, slayer of enemy heroes, fight Rishyashringa's son? Tell me truly just how it happened in the battle.

verses.text:
धनंजयश्च किं चक्रे मम सैन्येषु संजय ।
भीमो वा बलिनां श्रेष्ठो राक्षसो वा घटोत्कचः ॥

meaning.en: And what did Dhananjaya do among my troops, Sanjaya? What did Bhima, best of the mighty, or the rakshasa Ghatotkacha do?

verses.text:
नकुलः सहदेवो वा सात्यकिर्वा महारथः ।
एतदाचक्ष्व मे सर्वं कुशलो ह्यसि संजय ॥

meaning.en: What did Nakula, Sahadeva, or the great chariot-warrior Satyaki do? Tell me all this, for you are skilled in telling.

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
हन्त तेऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि संग्रामं लोमहर्षणम् ।
यथाभूद्राक्षसेन्द्रस्य सौभद्रस्य च मारिष ॥

meaning.en: Indeed, I will tell you of that hair-raising battle, my lord, as it took place between the king of the rakshasas and Saubhadra.

verses.text:
अर्जुनश्च यथा संख्ये भीमसेनश्च पाण्डवः ।
नकुलः सहदेवश्च रणे चक्रुः पराक्रमम् ॥

meaning.en: And I will tell how Arjuna, Bhimasena the Pandava, Nakula, and Sahadeva showed their prowess in the battle.

verses.text:
तथैव तावकाः सर्वे भीष्मद्रोणपुरोगमाः ।
अद्भुतानि विचित्राणि चक्रुः कर्माण्यभीतवत् ॥

meaning.en: In the same way all your men, led by Bhishma and Drona, did strange and wonderful deeds fearlessly.

verses.text:
अलम्बुसस्तु समरे अभिमन्युं महारथम् ।
विनद्य सुमहानादं तर्जयित्वा मुहुर्मुहुः ।
अभिदुद्राव वेगेन तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Alambusha, in the battle, roared a mighty roar at the great chariot-warrior Abhimanyu, threatened him again and again, and rushed at him swiftly, crying, "Stand! Stand!"

verses.text:
सौभद्रोऽपि रणे राजन्सिंहवद्विनदन्मुहुः ।
आर्श्यशृङ्गिं महेष्वासं पितुरत्यन्तवैरिणम् ॥

meaning.en: And Saubhadra too, O king, roaring again and again like a lion, faced the great archer, Rishyashringa's son, his father's deadly enemy.

verses.text:
ततः समेयतुः संख्ये त्वरितौ नरराक्षसौ ।
रथाभ्यां रथिनां श्रेष्ठौ यथा वै देवदानवौ ।
मायावी राक्षसश्रेष्ठो दिव्यास्त्रज्ञश्च फाल्गुनिः ॥

meaning.en: Then the man and the rakshasa, best of charioteers, swiftly met in the fight, each on his chariot, like a god and a demon, the one master of illusion, the best of rakshasas, the other, Phalguna's son, knower of divine weapons.

verses.text:
ततः कार्ष्णिर्महाराज निशितैः सायकैस्त्रिभिः ।
आर्श्यशृङ्गिं रणे विद्ध्वा पुनर्विव्याध पञ्चभिः ॥

meaning.en: Then Krishna's nephew, great king, pierced Rishyashringa's son in the battle with three sharp arrows and again with five.

verses.text:
अलम्बुसोऽपि संक्रुद्धः कार्ष्णिं नवभिराशुगैः ।
हृदि विव्याध वेगेन तोत्त्रैरिव महाद्विपम् ॥

meaning.en: Alambusha too, enraged, pierced Arjuna's son in the chest with nine swift arrows, as one prods a great elephant with goads.

verses.text:
ततः शरसहस्रेण क्षिप्रकारी निशाचरः ।
अर्जुनस्य सुतं संख्ये पीडयामास भारत ॥

meaning.en: Then the swift night-ranger afflicted Arjuna's son in the battle with a thousand arrows, Bharata.

verses.text:
अभिमन्युस्ततः क्रुद्धो नवतिं नतपर्वणाम् ।
चिक्षेप निशितान्बाणान्राक्षसस्य महोरसि ॥

meaning.en: Abhimanyu, then angry, shot ninety sharp, bent-jointed arrows into the rakshasa's broad chest.

verses.text:
ते तस्य विविशुस्तूर्णं कायं निर्भिद्य मर्मणि ।
स तैर्विभिन्नसर्वाङ्गः शुशुभे राक्षसोत्तमः ।
पुष्पितैः किंशुकै राजन्संस्तीर्ण इव पर्वतः ॥

meaning.en: They quickly entered his body, tearing it at the vital parts. Pierced in every limb by them, that best of rakshasas shone, O king, like a mountain covered with blossoming kimshuka trees.

verses.text:
स धारयञ्शरान्हेमपुङ्खानपि महाबलः ।
विबभौ राक्षसश्रेष्ठः सज्वाल इव पर्वतः ॥

meaning.en: Bearing the gold-feathered arrows, that mighty best of rakshasas looked like a mountain ablaze.

verses.text:
ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज आर्श्यशृङ्गिर्महाबलः ।
महेन्द्रप्रतिमं कार्ष्णिं छादयामास पत्रिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Then Rishyashringa's mighty son, enraged, great king, covered Krishna's nephew, who was like great Indra, with his arrows.

verses.text:
तेन ते विशिखा मुक्ता यमदण्डोपमाः शिताः ।
अभिमन्युं विनिर्भिद्य प्राविशन्धरणीतलम् ॥

meaning.en: The sharp shafts he loosed, like Yama's rod, pierced Abhimanyu and went into the ground.

verses.text:
तथैवार्जुनिनिर्मुक्ताः शराः काञ्चनभूषणाः ।
अलम्बुसं विनिर्भिद्य प्राविशन्त धरातलम् ॥

meaning.en: Likewise the gold-adorned arrows loosed by Arjuna's son pierced Alambusha and entered the ground.

verses.text:
सौभद्रस्तु रणे रक्षः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः ।
चक्रे विमुखमासाद्य मयं शक्र इवाहवे ॥

meaning.en: Saubhadra made the rakshasa turn away in the battle with his bent-jointed arrows, as Shakra did Maya.

verses.text:
विमुखं च ततो रक्षो वध्यमानं रणेऽरिणा ।
प्रादुश्चक्रे महामायां तामसीं परतापनः ॥

meaning.en: Then, turned back and pressed in battle by his foe, the rakshasa, tormentor of enemies, called up a great illusion of darkness.

verses.text:
ततस्ते तमसा सर्वे हृता ह्यासन्महीतले ।
नाभिमन्युमपश्यन्त नैव स्वान्न परान्रणे ॥

meaning.en: Then all were swallowed up by the darkness on the ground; they saw neither Abhimanyu nor their own men nor the enemy in the battle.

verses.text:
अभिमन्युश्च तद्दृष्ट्वा घोररूपं महत्तमः ।
प्रादुश्चक्रेऽस्त्रमत्युग्रं भास्करं कुरुनन्दनः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that great, fearful darkness, Abhimanyu, delight of the Kurus, brought forth the very fierce solar weapon.

verses.text:
ततः प्रकाशमभवज्जगत्सर्वं महीपते ।
तां चापि जघ्निवान्मायां राक्षसस्य दुरात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Then the whole world became light, O lord of the earth, and he destroyed the rakshasa's evil illusion.

verses.text:
संक्रुद्धश्च महावीर्यो राक्षसेन्द्रं नरोत्तमः ।
छादयामास समरे शरैः संनतपर्वभिः ॥

meaning.en: Greatly enraged, that mighty best of men covered the king of the rakshasas in the battle with bent-jointed arrows.

verses.text:
बह्वीस्तथान्या मायाश्च प्रयुक्तास्तेन रक्षसा ।
सर्वास्त्रविदमेयात्मा वारयामास फाल्गुनिः ॥

meaning.en: The many other illusions that the rakshasa employed, Phalguni's son, of immeasurable spirit and skilled in all weapons, warded off.

verses.text:
हतमायं ततो रक्षो वध्यमानं च सायकैः ।
रथं तत्रैव संत्यज्य प्राद्रवन्महतो भयात् ॥

meaning.en: Then, his illusions destroyed and struck by arrows, the rakshasa left his chariot right there and fled in great fear.

verses.text:
तस्मिन्विनिर्जिते तूर्णं कूटयोधिनि राक्षसे ।
आर्जुनिः समरे सैन्यं तावकं संममर्द ह ।
मदान्धो वन्यनागेन्द्रः सपद्मां पद्मिनीमिव ॥

meaning.en: When that rakshasa, a fighter by trickery, had been quickly beaten, Arjuna's son crushed your army in the battle, like a rutting wild elephant trampling a lotus pond with its lotuses.

verses.text:
ततः शांतनवो भीष्मः सैन्यं दृष्ट्वाभिविद्रुतम् ।
महता रथवंशेन सौभद्रं पर्यवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Then Bhishma son of Shantanu, seeing the army in flight, surrounded Saubhadra with a great line of chariots.

verses.text:
कोष्ठकीकृत्य तं वीरं धार्तराष्ट्रा महारथाः ।
एकं सुबहवो युद्धे ततक्षुः सायकैर्दृढम् ॥

meaning.en: Making that hero a target in their midst, the great chariot-warriors of the Dhartarashtras, many against one, battered him hard with arrows.

verses.text:
स तेषां रथिनां वीरः पितुस्तुल्यपराक्रमः ।
सदृशो वासुदेवस्य विक्रमेण बलेन च ॥

meaning.en: That hero, equal to his father in valour and like Vasudeva in prowess and strength, faced those charioteers.

verses.text:
उभयोः सदृशं कर्म स पितुर्मातुलस्य च ।
रणे बहुविधं चक्रे सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः ॥

meaning.en: The best of all weapon-bearers did in the battle many kinds of deeds equal to those of both his father and his maternal uncle.

verses.text:
ततो धनंजयो राजन्विनिघ्नंस्तव सैनिकान् ।
आससाद रणे भीष्मं पुत्रप्रेप्सुरमर्षणः ॥

meaning.en: Then Dhananjaya, killing your soldiers, O king, came upon Bhishma in the battle, angry and wishing to save his son.

verses.text:
तथैव समरे राजन्पिता देवव्रतस्तव ।
आससाद रणे पार्थं स्वर्भानुरिव भास्करम् ॥

meaning.en: Likewise your father Devavrata came against Partha in the battle, like Svarbhanu against the sun.

verses.text:
ततः सरथनागाश्वाः पुत्रास्तव विशां पते ।
परिवव्रू रणे भीष्मं जुगुपुश्च समन्ततः ॥

meaning.en: Then your sons, with chariots, elephants, and horses, surrounded Bhishma in the battle and guarded him on all sides.

verses.text:
तथैव पाण्डवा राजन्परिवार्य धनंजयम् ।
रणाय महते युक्ता दंशिता भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: And in the same way the Pandavas, O king, surrounded Dhananjaya, armoured and ready for the great fight, bull of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
शारद्वतस्ततो राजन्भीष्मस्य प्रमुखे स्थितम् ।
अर्जुनं पञ्चविंशत्या सायकानां समाचिनोत् ॥

meaning.en: Then Sharadvata's son Kripa, standing in front of Bhishma, loaded Arjuna with twenty-five arrows.

verses.text:
प्रत्युद्गम्याथ विव्याध सात्यकिस्तं शितैः शरैः ।
पाण्डवप्रियकामार्थं शार्दूल इव कुञ्जरम् ॥

meaning.en: Satyaki went forward and pierced Kripa with sharp arrows, like a tiger on an elephant, wishing to please the Pandavas.

verses.text:
गौतमोऽपि त्वरायुक्तो माधवं नवभिः शरैः ।
हृदि विव्याध संक्रुद्धः कङ्कपत्रपरिच्छदैः ॥

meaning.en: And Gautama Kripa, quickly and enraged, pierced Madhava Satyaki in the chest with nine arrows decked with heron feathers.

verses.text:
शैनेयोऽपि ततः क्रुद्धो भृशं विद्धो महारथः ।
गौतमान्तकरं घोरं समादत्त शिलीमुखम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Shaineya, the great chariot-warrior, angry and sorely hurt, took up a fearful arrow that was to be the end of Gautama.

verses.text:
तमापतन्तं वेगेन शक्राशनिसमद्युतिम् ।
द्विधा चिच्छेद संक्रुद्धो द्रौणिः परमकोपनः ॥

meaning.en: As it flew swiftly, bright as Shakra's thunderbolt, the very wrathful son of Drona, in rage, cut it in two.

verses.text:
समुत्सृज्याथ शैनेयो गौतमं रथिनां वरम् ।
अभ्यद्रवद्रणे द्रौणिं राहुः खे शशिनं यथा ॥

meaning.en: Then Shaineya left Gautama, best of charioteers, and rushed at Drona's son in the battle, as Rahu rushes at the moon in the sky.

verses.text:
तस्य द्रोणसुतश्चापं द्विधा चिच्छेद भारत ।
अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं ताडयामास सायकैः ॥

meaning.en: Drona's son cut his bow in two, Bharata, and then struck him, with his bow cut, with arrows.

verses.text:
सोऽन्यत्कार्मुकमादाय शत्रुघ्नं भारसाधनम् ।
द्रौणिं षष्ट्या महाराज बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत् ॥

meaning.en: Taking another bow, one that bears strain and destroys foes, Satyaki pierced Drona's son with sixty arrows in the arms and chest, great king.

verses.text:
स विद्धो व्यथितश्चैव मुहूर्तं कश्मलायुतः ।
निषसाद रथोपस्थे ध्वजयष्टिमुपाश्रितः ॥

meaning.en: Wounded and in pain, for a moment faint with dizziness, Drona's son sank down on his chariot-seat, leaning on the flagstaff.

verses.text:
प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञां द्रोणपुत्रः प्रतापवान् ।
वार्ष्णेयं समरे क्रुद्धो नाराचेन समर्दयत् ॥

meaning.en: Then, regaining his senses, mighty Drona's son, enraged, struck the Vrishni Satyaki with an iron arrow in the battle.

verses.text:
शैनेयं स तु निर्भिद्य प्राविशद्धरणीतलम् ।
वसन्तकाले बलवान्बिलं सर्पशिशुर्यथा ॥

meaning.en: It pierced Shaineya and went into the ground, as a powerful young snake enters its hole in the spring.

verses.text:
ततोऽपरेण भल्लेन माधवस्य ध्वजोत्तमम् ।
चिच्छेद समरे द्रौणिः सिंहनादं ननाद च ॥

meaning.en: Then with another broad-headed arrow Drona's son cut down the fine standard of Madhava in the battle and gave a lion's roar.

verses.text:
पुनश्चैनं शरैर्घोरैश्छादयामास भारत ।
निदाघान्ते महाराज यथा मेघो दिवाकरम् ॥

meaning.en: And again he covered him with terrible arrows, Bharata, as at the end of summer a cloud covers the sun, great king.

verses.text:
सात्यकिश्च महाराज शरजालं निहत्य तत् ।
द्रौणिमभ्यपतत्तूर्णं शरजालैरनेकधा ॥

meaning.en: Satyaki, great king, beat off that net of arrows and swiftly fell upon Drona's son with nets of arrows in many ways.

verses.text:
तापयामास च द्रौणिं शैनेयः परवीरहा ।
विमुक्तो मेघजालेन यथैव तपनस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Shaineya, slayer of enemy heroes, then scorched Drona's son, like the sun freed from a mass of clouds.

verses.text:
शराणां च सहस्रेण पुनरेनं समुद्यतम् ।
सात्यकिश्छादयामास ननाद च महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: And again with a thousand arrows the mighty Satyaki covered him as he rose to strike, and roared.

verses.text:
दृष्ट्वा पुत्रं तथा ग्रस्तं राहुणेव निशाकरम् ।
अभ्यद्रवत शैनेयं भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing his son seized as Rahu seizes the moon, the glorious son of Bharadvaja rushed at Shaineya.

verses.text:
विव्याध च पृषत्केन सुतीक्ष्णेन महामृधे ।
परीप्सन्स्वसुतं राजन्वार्ष्णेयेनाभितापितम् ॥

meaning.en: He pierced him in that great fight with a very sharp arrow, O king, wishing to save his own son, who was being tormented by the Vrishni.

verses.text:
सात्यकिस्तु रणे जित्वा गुरुपुत्रं महारथम् ।
द्रोणं विव्याध विंशत्या सर्वपारशवैः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: But Satyaki, having defeated his teacher's son, a great chariot-warrior, in the battle, pierced Drona with twenty iron arrows.

verses.text:
तदन्तरममेयात्मा कौन्तेयः श्वेतवाहनः ।
अभ्यद्रवद्रणे क्रुद्धो द्रोणं प्रति महारथः ॥

meaning.en: Meanwhile Kunti's son, the white-horsed one of immeasurable spirit, a great chariot-warrior, in anger rushed at Drona in the battle.

verses.text:
ततो द्रोणश्च पार्थश्च समेयातां महामृधे ।
यथा बुधश्च शुक्रश्च महाराज नभस्तले ॥

meaning.en: Then Drona and Partha met in that great fight, great king, like Mercury and Venus in the sky.
